title: Structural biology in variant interpretation: Perspectives and practices from two studies.
authors: Varga, Matthew J; Richardson, Marcy E; Chamberlin, Adam
one_liner_zh: 该文讨论结构生物学在遗传变异解读中的应用，涉及AlphaFold等工具，但核心是变异功能解读而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制建模，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Structural biology offers a powerful lens through which to assess genetic variants by providing insights into their impact on clinically relevant protein structure and function. Due to the availability of new, user-friendly, web-based tools, structural analyses by wider audiences have become more mainstream. These new tools, including AlphaMissense and AlphaFold, have recently been in the limelight due to their initial success and projected future promise; however, the intricacies and limitations of using these tools still need to be disseminated to the more general audience that is likely to use them in variant analysis. Here, we expound on frameworks applying structural biology to variant interpretation by examining two accompanying articles. To this end, we explore the nuances of choosing the correct protein model, compare and contrast various structural approaches, and highlight both the advantages and limitations of employing structural biology in variant interpretation. Using two articles published in this issue of The American Journal of Human Genetics as a baseline, we focus on case studies in TP53 and BRCA1 to illuminate gene-specific differences in the applications of structural information, which illustrate the complexities inherent in this field. Additionally, we discuss the implications of recent advancements, such as AlphaFold, and provide practical guidance for researchers navigating variant interpretation using structural biology.
abstract_zh: 结构生物学通过提供对临床相关蛋白质结构与功能影响的见解，为评估遗传变异提供了一个强有力的视角。随着新的、用户友好的网络工具的出现，更广泛受众进行结构分析已变得更加主流。这些新工具，包括AlphaMissense和AlphaFold，因其初步成功和预期的未来前景而近期备受瞩目；然而，使用这些工具的复杂性和局限性仍需向可能将其用于变异分析的更广泛受众传播。在此，我们通过审视两篇随附文章，阐述将结构生物学应用于变异解读的框架。为此，我们探讨了选择正确蛋白质模型的细微差别，比较和对比了各种结构方法，并强调了在变异解读中采用结构生物学的优势与局限性。以本期《美国人类遗传学杂志》发表的两篇文章为基础，我们聚焦于TP53和BRCA1的案例研究，以阐明结构信息应用中基因特异性的差异，这些差异展示了该领域固有的复杂性。此外，我们讨论了诸如AlphaFold等近期进展的影响，并为研究人员利用结构生物学进行变异解读提供了实用指导。
